response.justification: Bogdan meets the 15-year minimum requirement with 20+ years of software engineering experience and is currently working on AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq, which aligns with the role's AI strategy focus. However, significant concerns include: his AI work is very recent (only 4 months), he lacks the preferred Master's/PhD in AI, and there's no evidence of director-level strategic leadership or experience advising enterprise customers on technology adoption—key responsibilities for this principal-level role. His strong technical background is primarily as a senior individual contributor rather than a strategic leader.
strengths: 20+ years of software engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure, exceeding the 15-year minimum requirement
Currently working on AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic workflows at re:cinq, directly aligned with the AI strategy focus
Proven cloud infrastructure expertise including AWS CDK, Kubernetes, Docker, and experience with high-scale systems handling millions of requests
concerns: AI expertise is very recent (only 4 months in current role); no demonstrated track record of shipped AI products or platforms
Lacks Master's degree or PhD in AI-related field, which is a preferred qualification for this AI strategy role
No evidence of director-level strategic leadership or experience advising enterprise customers/partners on technology adoption decisions
